Hi Olga,

Thanks for taking this. Our security team is reviewing the CAIQ and SIG responses and has a couple of follow-ups specific to log handling. They need:

1) A short architecture diagram or statement confirming tenant-wise separation of application/audit logs (how logs are scoped to customer tenancy, where they sit).
2) The deletion workflow and proof-of-delete timeline for tenant-requested erasure (what gets deleted, retention windows, certs).
3) Whether privileged access to raw logs is segmented or requires additional approvals.

Can you point us to a document or provide a brief attestation we can present to our InfoSec reviewers? Ideally by EOW next week.

Also, if you have a sample attestation we can sign (DocuSign), that would speed things up.

Hi all — attaching the artifacts referenced below. Short answers up front:

- Tenant segmentation: logs are tagged at ingestion with tenant_id and routed into tenant-scoped indexes (logical separation); diagram attached (log-segmentation-diagram.png).
- Storage: tenant indexes live on per-tenant namespaces in our logging cluster; snapshots for disaster recovery are stored separately and associated to the tenant id.
- Deletion: customer deletion triggers the "Tenant Erasure" workflow in our runbook; primary data and indexed logs are removed within 24–48 hours, snapshot expiry is scheduled and certified within 30 calendar days; see tenant-deletion-playbook.pdf.
- Privileged access: there is an RBAC gate — access to raw tenant logs requires a documented change request and two approvers (SRE lead + Security). All accesses are logged and audited.

Attachments: log-segmentation-diagram.png (diagram, redacted), tenant-deletion-playbook.pdf (runbook excerpt).

If Horizon needs amended SLA language for the attestation, flag the exact line items and Rishi will incorporate.

-Neha
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com, liam@horizon-labs.com
Date: Sat, 30 May 2026 11:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence request: per-tenant log separation + deletion attestation

Liam / Olga — drafting below as the proposed attestation text. If OK I can drop into the attestation-template.docx and send via DocuSign.

---PROPOSED ATTESTATION---
Redwood Inference confirms the following as of date 2026-05-30:
1) Logical segmentation: Production application and audit logs are ingested with tenant identifiers and stored in tenant-scoped namespaces. Logical separation ensures no cross-tenant indexing or co-mingling of searchable log data.
2) Deletion workflow: Upon an authorized tenant erasure request, Redwood removes primary log indexes within 24–48 hours and schedules snapshot purging; final evidence of deletion (deletion manifest) is provided within 30 calendar days.
3) Privileged access controls: Access to raw tenant log data is restricted via RBAC; approval requires two approvers (SRE lead and Security); all access events are logged and retained for 90 days.
4) Exceptions: For legal holds or investigatory matters, Redwood will notify the tenant and maintain data as required by law.

If this language looks good to Horizon I will prepare the attestation doc and send for signature.

-Rishi
Director, Compliance Engineering, Redwood Inference
